title: A vision transformer for decoding surgeon activity from surgical videos.
summary: The primary article reports a vision-transformer system that decodes surgical steps, actions and skill-related quality from videos across three hospitals; this is a specific clinical measurement study, with no claim of improved surgical outcomes.
